description_en: Queries the details of a Network Load Balancer (NLB) listener
description_zh: 查询网络型负载均衡实例的监听详情
kebab_example: aliyun nlb get-listener-attribute --listener-id lsn-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000@233 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, without sending the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询监听详情。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among all requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, ClientToken is set to the value of RequestId. The value of RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The operation to query the attributes of a listener

AlpnEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation (ALPN) is enabled. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
AlpnEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启ALPN。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

AlpnPolicy.description_en:
The ALPN policy. Valid values:

HTTP1Only

HTTP2Only

HTTP2Preferred

HTTP2Optional
AlpnPolicy.description_zh:
ALPN策略。取值：

HTTP1Only
HTTP2Only
HTTP2Preferred
HTTP2Optional

CaCertificateIds.description_en:
The CA certificates. Only one CA certificate is supported.

This parameter takes effect only for listeners that use SSL over TCP
CaCertificateIds.description_zh:
CA证书列表信息。目前仅支持添加1个CA证书。
该参数仅对TCPSSL监听生效

items.description_en:
The CA certificates. Only one CA certificate is supported.

This parameter takes effect only for listeners that use SSL over TCP
items.description_zh:
CA证书列表信息。目前仅支持添加1个CA证书。
该参数仅对TCPSSL监听生效

CaEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether mutual authentication is enabled. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
CaEnabled.description_zh:
是否启动双向认证。取值：

true：启动。

false：关闭

CertificateIds.description_en:
The server certificates. Only one server certificate is supported.

This parameter takes effect only for listeners that use SSL over TCP
CertificateIds.description_zh:
服务器证书列表信息。目前仅支持添加1个服务器证书。

该参数仅对TCPSSL监听生效

items.description_zh:
服务器证书列表信息。目前仅支持添加1个服务器证书。

该参数仅对TCPSSL监听生效

Cps.description_en: The maximum number of new connections per second supported by the listener in each zone (virtual IP address). Valid values: 0 to 1000000. 0 indicates that the number of connections is unlimited
Cps.description_zh: 该监听在每个可用区（VIP）处理的每秒新建连接限速值。取值范围：0~1000000。0表示不限速

EndPort.description_en: The last port in the listening port range. Valid values: 0 to 65535. The number of the last port must be smaller than that of the first port
EndPort.description_zh: 全端口监听结束端口。取值范围：0~ 65535。结束端口的取值小于起始端口

IdleTimeout.description_en: The timeout period of an idle connection. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 900
IdleTimeout.description_zh: 连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒

ListenerDescription.description_en:
The name of the listener.

The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
ListenerDescription.description_zh:
自定义监听名称。

长度限制为2~256个字符，支持中文和英文字母，可包含数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

ListenerPort.description_en: The listening port. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A value of 0 specifies all ports. If you set the value to 0, you must also set the StartPort and EndPort parameters
ListenerPort.description_zh: 监听端口。取值范围：0~65535。0：表示使用全端口监听。当设置为0时，您需要配置StartPort和EndPort

ListenerProtocol.description_en: The listening protocol. Valid values: TCP, UDP, and TCPSSL
ListenerProtocol.title_en: 监听协议 (TCP, UDP, TCPSSL, GENEVE)
ListenerProtocol.title_zh: 监听协议 (TCP, UDP, TCPSSL, GENEVE)

ListenerStatus.description_en:
The status of the listener. Valid values:

Provisioning: The listener is being created.

Running: The listener is running.

Configuring: The listener is being configured.

Stopping: The listener is being stopped.

Stopped: The listener is stopped.

Starting: The listener is being started.

Deleting: The listener is being deleted.

Deleted: The listener is deleted
ListenerStatus.description_zh:
当前监听的状态，取值：

Provisioning：创建中。

Running：运行中。

Configuring：配置中。

Stopping：停止中。

Stopped：已停止。

Starting：启动中。

Deleting：删除中。

Deleted：已删除

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the NLB instance

Mss.description_en:
The size of the largest TCP segment. Unit: bytes. Valid values: 0 to 1500. 0 specifies that the maximum segment size remains unchanged.

This parameter is supported only by listeners that use SSL over TCP
Mss.description_zh:
TCP报文的最大段大小。单位：字节，取值范围：0~1500。0表示不修改用户TCP报文的MSS值。

仅TCP、TCPSSL类型的监听支持该字段值

ProxyProtocolEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Proxy protocol is used to pass client IP addresses to backend servers. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
ProxyProtocolEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启通过Proxy Protocol协议携带客户端源地址到后端服务器。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

ProxyProtocolV2Config.description_en: Indicates whether the Proxy protocol passes the VpcId, PrivateLinkEpId, and PrivateLinkEpsId parameters to backend servers
ProxyProtocolV2Config.description_zh: 通过Proxy Protocol协议携带VpcId、PrivateLinkEpId、PrivateLinkEpsId信息到后端服务器配置

Ppv2PrivateLinkEpIdEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Proxy protocol passes the PrivateLinkEpId parameter to backend servers. Valid values:

true

false
Ppv2PrivateLinkEpIdEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启通过Proxy Protocol协议携带PrivateLinkEpId到后端服务器。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

Ppv2PrivateLinkEpsIdEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Proxy protocol passes the PrivateLinkEpsId parameter to backend servers. Valid values:

true

false
Ppv2PrivateLinkEpsIdEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启通过Proxy Protocol协议携带PrivateLinkEpsId到后端服务器。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

Ppv2VpcIdEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Proxy protocol passes the VpcId parameter to backend servers. Valid values:

true

false
Ppv2VpcIdEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启通过Proxy Protocol协议携带VpcId到后端服务器。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the NLB instance is deployed
RegionId.description_zh: 网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。

SecSensorEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether fine-grained monitoring is enabled. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
SecSensorEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启秒级监控功能。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

SecurityPolicyId.description_en:
The ID of the security policy. System security policies and custom security policies are supported.

Valid values: tls_cipher_policy_1_0, tls_cipher_policy_1_1, tls_cipher_policy_1_2, tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict, and tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3.

Custom security policy: the ID of the custom security policy.

For more information about how to create a custom security policy, see [CreateSecurityPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399231.html） .

For more information about how to query security policies, see [ListSecurityPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399234.html） .

This parameter takes effect only for listeners that use SSL over TCP
SecurityPolicyId.description_zh:
安全策略ID。支持系统安全策略和自定义安全策略。

系统策略取值：tls_cipher_policy_1_0（默认值）、tls_cipher_policy_1_1、tls_cipher_policy_1_2、tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict或tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3。
自定义安全策略：输入自定义安全策略ID。
    - 创建自定义策略，请参见[CreateSecurityPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445901.html）。
    - 查询安全策略，请参见[ListSecurityPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445900.html）。

仅对TCPSSL监听生效

ServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the server group

StartPort.description_en: The first port in the listening port range. Valid values: 0 to 65535
StartPort.description_zh: 全端口监听起始端口。取值范围：0 ~ 65535
